2609.11911.title: Artificial Id: Drive and Persistent Alignment in Agentic AI
2609.11911.paper_summary: Agentic AI is moving from bounded task execution toward systems that retain consequential state, continue operating and adapt across task boundaries. That shift creates a control problem that current harnesses largely solve by hand: objectives, retries, verification, stopping rules and other behavioral transitions are specified externally. We propose an artificial id, an adaptive internal drive for determining whether behavior should continue, stop or change. In a minimal virtual Petri-dish experiment, a controller too small to perform general-purpose reasoning and receiving no task-specific behavioral objective develops useful control through differential persistence. The same mechanism selects an unintended physical strategy when that behavior persists better and later replaces a learned sensor mapping when its environmental meaning changes. These results show that adaptive direction can emerge without being explicitly specified as a behavioral objective. The same persistence that makes such adaptive agency useful can also allow misalignment, corrupted state and unintended behavior to persist across task boundaries. A scalable artificial id would carry consequential state and adaptive drive across those boundaries, making alignment a property of the continuing agentic system rather than of a model response or single trajectory. Such systems require a persistent alignment boundary over trusted observations, consequence channels, persistent state, authority, identity, provenance and hard constraints.
2609.11911.paper_summary_zh: 代理 AI 正在從有限的任務執行轉向保留後果狀態的系統，這些系統能夠持續運作並在任務邊界之間進行適應。這一轉變產生了一個控制問題，目前的解決方案大多依賴手動處理：目標、重試、驗證、停止規則以及其他行為轉換都是外部指定的。我們提出了一種人工 id，這是一種適應性的內部驅動，用於決定行為是否應該繼續、停止或改變。在一個最小的虛擬培養皿實驗中，一個過小而無法執行通用推理的控制器，並且沒有接收特定任務的行為目標，通過差異持續性發展出有用的控制。相同的機制在該行為持續存在時選擇了一種意外的物理策略，並在其環境意義發生變化時，隨後替換了一個學習到的傳感器映射。這些結果顯示，適應性方向可以在未明確指定為行為目標的情況下出現。使這種適應性代理有用的持續性也可能導致不一致、損壞的狀態和意外行為在任務邊界之間持續存在。一個可擴展的人工 id 將在這些邊界之間攜帶後果狀態和適應性驅動，使對齊成為持續代理系統的特性，而不是模型反應或單一軌跡的特性。這些系統需要在可信觀察、後果通道、持續狀態、權威、身份、來源和硬約束之間保持持久的對齊邊界。
